name: SPY Bear Market Episodes: Drawdown & Recovery
description: Analyzes 4 fixed bear market episodes for SPY (Dot-com, GFC, COVID, Rate Hike 2022). Shows rolling drawdown from all-time high over full history with episode shading, plus a summary table with each episode's peak date, trough date, max drawdown, and recovery duration in trading days.
source:
# ============================================================
# SPY Bear Market Episodes — Drawdown & Recovery Analysis
# 4 episodes: Dot-com, GFC, COVID, Rate Hike 2022
# Rolling drawdown with episode shading + summary table
# ============================================================

# --- Data ---
src = study_assets()
ts = index().value

# --- Rolling Drawdown from All-Time High ---
cum_max = agg(src.c, AggregationType.Max)
drawdown = (src.c - cum_max) / cum_max

# --- Episode Date Boundaries (Timestamps) ---
# Episode 1: Dot-com (2000-03-24 to 2002-10-09)
dc_start = Timestamp(value="2000-03-24")
dc_end   = Timestamp(value="2002-10-09")

# Episode 2: GFC (2007-10-09 to 2009-03-09)
gfc_start = Timestamp(value="2007-10-09")
gfc_end   = Timestamp(value="2009-03-09")

# Episode 3: COVID (2020-02-19 to 2020-03-23)
cov_start = Timestamp(value="2020-02-19")
cov_end   = Timestamp(value="2020-03-23")

# Episode 4: Rate Hike 2022 (2022-01-03 to 2022-10-12)
rh_start = Timestamp(value="2022-01-03")
rh_end   = Timestamp(value="2022-10-12")

# --- Episode Boolean Flags ---
in_dc  = ts >= dc_start and ts <= dc_end
in_gfc = ts >= gfc_start and ts <= gfc_end
in_cov = ts >= cov_start and ts <= cov_end
in_rh  = ts >= rh_start and ts <= rh_end

# --- Max Drawdown per Episode (min of drawdown within window) ---
dd_dc  = agg(where(in_dc, drawdown), AggregationType.Min)
dd_gfc = agg(where(in_gfc, drawdown), AggregationType.Min)
dd_cov = agg(where(in_cov, drawdown), AggregationType.Min)
dd_rh  = agg(where(in_rh, drawdown), AggregationType.Min)

# --- Peak Close Before Each Episode (cum_max at episode start) ---
# The peak is the running max just before the episode begins
peak_dc  = valuewhen(in_dc, cum_max, occurrence=0)
peak_gfc = valuewhen(in_gfc, cum_max, occurrence=0)
peak_cov = valuewhen(in_cov, cum_max, occurrence=0)
peak_rh  = valuewhen(in_rh, cum_max, occurrence=0)

# --- Peak Date: first bar of each episode (when peak was set) ---
peak_date_dc  = valuewhen(in_dc, ts, occurrence=0)
peak_date_gfc = valuewhen(in_gfc, ts, occurrence=0)
peak_date_cov = valuewhen(in_cov, ts, occurrence=0)
peak_date_rh  = valuewhen(in_rh, ts, occurrence=0)

# --- Trough Date: bar with minimum drawdown in each episode ---
# Use the drawdown series filtered to episode, find the arg_min timestamp
trough_date_dc  = arg_min(where(in_dc, drawdown))
trough_date_gfc = arg_min(where(in_gfc, drawdown))
trough_date_cov = arg_min(where(in_cov, drawdown))
trough_date_rh  = arg_min(where(in_rh, drawdown))

# --- Recovery Duration ---
# Count bars from episode end until close >= pre-episode peak
# Recovery = barssince(condition became true) measured from after trough
# We detect when close first recovers to peak level after each episode end

# For each episode: after the episode ends, how many bars until close >= peak?
# recovered_dc = src.c >= peak_dc (this is True once price recovers)
# We want the FIRST bar after episode end where this is true
# barssince gives bars since condition was last true — we need the inverse

# Approach: count bars from episode end to first recovery
# post_episode flag + cumulative count until recovery
post_dc  = ts > dc_end
post_gfc = ts > gfc_end
post_cov = ts > cov_end
post_rh  = ts > rh_end

# Recovery flags: first time close >= peak after episode
recovered_dc  = post_dc and src.c >= peak_dc
recovered_gfc = post_gfc and src.c >= peak_gfc
recovered_cov = post_cov and src.c >= peak_cov
recovered_rh  = post_rh and src.c >= peak_rh

# Count trading days from episode end to first recovery
# barssince(post_dc) gives bars since post_dc became true = bars since episode ended
# We want the barssince value at the first recovery bar
recovery_days_dc  = valuewhen(recovered_dc, barssince(post_dc), occurrence=0)
recovery_days_gfc = valuewhen(recovered_gfc, barssince(post_gfc), occurrence=0)
recovery_days_cov = valuewhen(recovered_cov, barssince(post_cov), occurrence=0)
recovery_days_rh  = valuewhen(recovered_rh, barssince(post_rh), occurrence=0)

# --- CHART: Rolling Drawdown with Episode Shading ---
# x_plot_bands use millisecond timestamps for from/to
# Dot-com: 2000-03-24 = 953856000000, 2002-10-09 = 1034121600000
# GFC:     2007-10-09 = 1191888000000, 2009-03-09 = 1236556800000
# COVID:   2020-02-19 = 1582070400000, 2020-03-23 = 1584921600000
# Rate Hike: 2022-01-03 = 1641168000000, 2022-10-12 = 1665532800000

xy_lines(
    title='How Deep Did SPY Fall? Rolling Drawdown from All-Time High',
    y_axis_label='Drawdown',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    x_axis_label='',
    category='Bear Market Episodes',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Drawdown', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    x_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=953856000000, to=1034121600000, color=Color.Red, opacity=0.12, label='Dot-com'),
        PlotBand(from=1191888000000, to=1236556800000, color=Color.Orange, opacity=0.12, label='GFC'),
        PlotBand(from=1582070400000, to=1584921600000, color=Color.Purple, opacity=0.12, label='COVID'),
        PlotBand(from=1641168000000, to=1665532800000, color=Color.Teal, opacity=0.12, label='2022')
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='All-Time High', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid),
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.20, title='-20% Bear Threshold', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=ts, y_values=drawdown)

# --- TABLE: Episode Summary ---
# 4 episodes × 4 metrics = 16 cells
# Rows: Dot-com, GFC, COVID, Rate Hike 2022
# Cols: Peak Date, Trough Date, Max Drawdown, Recovery (Days)
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Bear Market Episodes',
    order=1,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Bear Market Episode Summary',
        row_size=4, col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Dot-com', 'GFC', 'COVID', 'Rate Hike 2022'],
        col_headers=['Peak Date', 'Trough Date', 'Max Drawdown', 'Recovery (Days)'],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: Dot-com
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DateFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DateFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            # Row 1: GFC
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DateFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DateFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            # Row 2: COVID
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DateFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DateFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            # Row 3: Rate Hike 2022
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DateFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DateFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    )
)(peak_date_dc, trough_date_dc, dd_dc, recovery_days_dc,
  peak_date_gfc, trough_date_gfc, dd_gfc, recovery_days_gfc,
  peak_date_cov, trough_date_cov, dd_cov, recovery_days_cov,
  peak_date_rh, trough_date_rh, dd_rh, recovery_days_rh)
